acceptance_criteria: Guard condition implemented. Oracle: §2.3. Tests pass.
close_reason: Added main_ops_all_succeeded guard: onSuccessSetIsDefault skipped when any notCreated/notUpdated/notDestroyed is non-empty; 1 new test; 18 total pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Spec contacts-10 §2.3 says onSuccessSetIsDefault runs only 'if all creates, updates and destroys (if any) succeed without error'. Currently it runs unconditionally.

**Algorithm:**
1. After the main create/update/destroy loops and before the onSuccessSetIsDefault block, add:
   let main_ops_all_succeeded = not_created.is_empty() && not_updated.is_empty() && not_destroyed.is_empty();
   if main_ops_all_succeeded { /* run onSuccessSetIsDefault block (from J1) */ }
2. Add test set_on_success_skipped_when_create_fails: create map with one entry that fails; assert onSuccessSetIsDefault is NOT applied (verified by MockBackend call count or by asserting updated does not contain the target).
3. cargo test -p jmap-contacts-server.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- onSuccessSetIsDefault not applied when any main op failed. Oracle: §2.3.
- When all main ops succeed, onSuccessSetIsDefault is applied.
- cargo test exits 0.
title: Fix: skip onSuccessSetIsDefault when any main set op failed
